safety_health_committee_001.evidence: The parties agree that there shall be a health and safety committee in each school. Composition of the committee shall be determined by the principal and faculty.

safety_assault_protection_002.evidence: Assault Leave: Up to twenty (20) duty days for time resulting from physical injuries caused by an assault while carrying out the duties and responsibilities of an educator. ... Any educator assaulted shall report the incident to the principal immediately.
